tips_en: Start with EnvHarness (Paper 1) as it introduces a broadly useful framework for improving LLM agents with strong empirical gains across multiple benchmarks. It pairs naturally with Paper 2, which evaluates coding agents on scientific software—both tackle complementary sides of agent capability (training vs. evaluation), while Paper 3 (4DAnyone) stands apart in vision/graphics and is better read independently.
tips_zh: 建议先读EnvHarness（论文1），它提出了一个通用性强且效果显著的LLM智能体改进框架。它与论文2高度互补——前者聚焦智能体训练，后者聚焦代码智能体评估，可一并阅读；论文3（4DAnyone）属于视觉/图形领域，独立阅读即可。
